title: Ladies Day Results

sections.alt: Ladies Day banner — the Southwest Bowls palm-tree logo beside the words “Ladies Day” in handwriting on a pale yellow field.

body: Ladies Day is a fun monthly event that brings the women of the division together for a day of competition and camaraderie. Each month different club hosts the event.

migrationNotes: This is an index page: a banner, one intro sentence, and links to the six per-year Ladies Day pages. The year links were arranged as an image/button grid in Squarespace in a scrambled order (2026, 2025, 2022, 2024, 2021, 2023); they are listed here newest-first.
The Squarespace browser title for this page is the unedited default “General 1”. The nav label — “Ladies Day Results” — is used as the page title instead.
Each year link in Squarespace carried a decorative thumbnail; those were not migrated, as the buttons carry the same information.
